text_block_list.text: One holiday. While out shopping...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Rice
text_block_list.text: Honey~, honey~, honey~♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Hachimi song singing complete. All 
missions related to "Honey Drink" have 
been fully executed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that was so delicious! I can 
totally see why Teio-san and the others 
are obsessed with it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Furthermore—when singing with 
Rice-san, the perceived sweetness of the 
beverage increased. ...I conclude that the 
singing stimulated the brain.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Operation "Best Friends Date" is 
progressing smoothly. Moving to the next 
execution site.

"Best Friends Date"... Come to think of 
it, earlier in the library, the two of 
them were—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Continuing this momentum into our next 
mission... "Bestie ☆ Best Pals Club" 
Volume 9, Chapter 8. Let us execute the 
"Best Friends Date."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm a little nervous, but... I'll do 
my best...!

..., They must be carrying out the plan 
they discussed back then.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing "Get Hyped with Aesthetic Pics 
at a Chic Cafe." ...Correction: 
Commencing, let's gooo.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-Okie-dokie! Then... let's take a 
two-shot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... we both closed our eyes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it appears to be a goofy 
photo, but merely visualising it causes 
the corners of my mouth to elevate. 
..."Aesthetics" are quite fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, have you decided on the matching 
sports towels we should purchase?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Rice-san, are you interested in that 
bracelet over there?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eep?! Ah, n-no, it's nothing! Um... there 
are so many matching towels, it's hard to 
choose!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. I wonder if we can point at the 
same towel at the same time, just like 
Kita-san and Satono-san did?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Simulation complete. Thank you for 
waiting. Let us commence pointing at the 
towels as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Aww... The store is already closing. 
Pointing at the exact same one is really 
tough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. However...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A proposal for Rice-san. Shall we consider 
this our matching achievement for today?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh... th-this is... ...Could it be the 
bracelet from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! We have matching bracelets now, 
Bourbon-san... Rice has to get you 
something in return too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about you present me 
with the matching sports towels next time? 
...Would that be acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah! You're right, that way we'll 
both be super happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'll do my best to nail the 
towel pointing next time, and then we can 
report back to your father, Bourbon-san~!

text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Rice
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to be best friends... Hip, hip, 
hooray!

I kept bumping into them wherever I went 
today, and seeing how they constantly 
cooperated together, they truly were the 
definition of a "Best Friends Pair."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
——...Consciousness level... dropping... 
confirmed. Abnormal physical status... 
detected...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh! Oh no, this is terrible! We need to 
find somewhere for you to rest...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Resting has stabilized my vital 
parameters. Disengaging sleep mode.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, Bourbon-san. In the end, 
Rice dragged you into something bad...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. The cause of my diminished 
operational capacity was a decline in 
sleep quality over the past several days, 
resulting in a bug within my stamina 
calculation algorithms.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words——I was looking forward to 
our "Best Friends Date" so much that I 
could not sleep.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san... You were looking forward to 
it that much...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I request a re-execution of the 
mission. I will gather operational 
knowledge to prevent a recurrence.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Then Rice will teach you a 
good-night charm so you can sleep well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, so first, you put a picture book about 
sheep by your pillow, and then——

I kept bumping into them wherever I went 
today, and seeing them work out solutions 
together, they truly were the definition 
of a "Best Friends Pair."
